posts.text: A late reply, this is SME space, very thin trading volume and small volumes can change prices widely. From fundamental, FY26 saw increase in revenue, however it was downgrade from OPM, PAT and EPS point of view. But interestingly CFO has significantly improved, not sure how many people saw this. Now, the prices will start reflecting the future once there is some communication from the company on the status of projects being implemented, which is lacking. I’m invested and on 20% loss
